ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe is characterized by a high-intensity white field with vertical low-intensity black streaks concentrated in the mid-lateral region. The right lobe is predominantly low-intensity black with high-intensity white mottling appearing at the distal tip. The central region near the notch is a solid block of low-intensity black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal angle of 65 degrees; notch depth is significant relative to the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration pattern along the trailing boundary of both lobes, featuring sharp peaks and narrow valleys with pixel-amplitude variations of approximately 5-12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the lateral lobe edges, transitioning into an upward-swept trajectory toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of tan and brown textured pixels at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, disrupting the primary pigmentation patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel vertical dark linear marks (approx. 5-7 distinct lines) on the high-intensity field of the left lobe, and parallel vertical light-grey linear marks on the low-intensity field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent textured masses and associated discoloration (likely barnacle colonization) at the distal tips; the left tip exhibits a more irregular, jagged profile compared to the right.
